description:
PLEASE SEE THE ATTACHED RFI.

A response is requested by April 3, 2026, to Anna Lake (anna.lake@dla.mil) and Avril Dickerson (avril.dickerson@dla.mil) 

THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (RFP). NO SOLICITATION IS AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME.

The Department of Defense (DOD) Defense Logistics Agency – Troop Support’s Construction & Equipment Directorate is seeking information from industry to assist in determining compliance of containers in the 8150 Federal Supply Code (FSC) with the updated regulations at DFARS 252.225-7001 Buy American and Balance of Payments Program (BAA), published on November 25, 2024.
